metadata.title: Chapter 7: Coordinate Geometry (Mock Test)
metadata.subtitle: Test Your Understanding
metadata.subject: Maths
metadata.author: Antigravity
learning_outcomes: Apply distance and section formulas to solve varied coordinate geometry problems.
Determine collinearity and verify properties of geometric figures using coordinates.

ai_context.learning_goal: Assess the student's mastery of Chapter 7 through randomized questions from the exercises.

blocks.question: Find the point on the x-axis which is equidistant from (2, -5) and (-2, 9).
blocks.question_hi: x-अक्ष पर वह बिंदु ज्ञात कीजिए जो (2, -5) और (-2, 9) से समदूरस्थ हो।
blocks.question_gu: x-અક્ષ પર તે બિંદુ શોધો જે (2, -5) અને (-2, 9) થી સમાન અંતરે હોય.

blocks.question: Find the values of y for which the distance between the points P(2, -3) and Q(10, y) is 10 units.
blocks.question_hi: y के वे मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिनके लिए बिंदुओं P(2, -3) और Q(10, y) के बीच की दूरी 10 इकाई है।
blocks.question_gu: y ના એવા મૂલ્યો શોધો જેના માટે બિંદુઓ P(2, -3) અને Q(10, y) વચ્ચેનું અંતર 10 એકમ છે.

blocks.question: Find the ratio in which the line segment joining A(1, -5) and B(-4, 5) is divided by the x-axis.
blocks.question_hi: वह अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए जिसमें A(1, -5) और B(-4, 5) को मिलाने वाला रेखाखंड x-अक्ष द्वारा विभाजित होता है।
blocks.question_gu: તે ગુણોત્તર શોધો જેમાં A(1, -5) અને B(-4, 5) ને જોડતો રેખાખંડ x-અક્ષ દ્વારા વિભાજિત થાય છે.
blocks.explanation: Point on x-axis has y-coordinate 0. y = (m₁y₂ + m₂y₁) / (m₁ + m₂). 0 = (k*5 + 1*-5) / (k+1). 5k - 5 = 0. k = 1. Ratio is 1:1.
blocks.explanation_hi: x-अक्ष पर बिंदु का y-निर्देशांक 0 होता है। y = (m₁y₂ + m₂y₁) / (m₁ + m₂)। 0 = (k*5 + 1*-5) / (k+1)। 5k - 5 = 0। k = 1। अनुपात 1:1 है।
blocks.explanation_gu: x-અક્ષ પર બિંદુનો y-યામ 0 છે. y = (m₁y₂ + m₂y₁) / (m₁ + m₂). 0 = (k*5 + 1*-5) / (k+1). 5k - 5 = 0. k = 1. ગુણોત્તર 1:1 છે.

blocks.question: What is one of the coordinates of the points of trisection of the line segment joining (4, -1) and (-2, -3)?
blocks.question_hi: (4, -1) और (-2, -3) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड के समत्रिभाजन बिंदुओं में से एक के निर्देशांक क्या हैं?
blocks.question_gu: (4, -1) અને (-2, -3) ને જોડતા રેખાખંડના ત્રિભાગ બિંદુઓમાંથી એકના યામ શું છે?
blocks.explanation: Trisection points divide in ratio 1:2 and 2:1. For 1:2, x = (1*-2 + 2*4)/3 = 6/3 = 2. y = (1*-3 + 2*-1)/3 = -5/3. Point is (2, -5/3).

blocks.question: If (1, 2), (4, y), (x, 6) and (3, 5) are the vertices of a parallelogram taken in order, find x and y.
blocks.question_hi: यदि (1, 2), (4, y), (x, 6) और (3, 5) एक समांतर चतुर्भुज के शीर्ष हैं जिन्हें क्रम में लिया गया है, तो x और y ज्ञात कीजिए।
blocks.question_gu: જો (1, 2), (4, y), (x, 6) અને (3, 5) ક્રમમાં લેવાયેલા સમાંતરબાજુ ચતુષ્કોણના શિરોબિંદુઓ છે, તો x અને y શોધો.
blocks.explanation: Midpoints of diagonals are equal. Midpoint of AC = Midpoint of BD. ((1+x)/2, (2+6)/2) = ((4+3)/2, (y+5)/2). (1+x)/2 = 7/2 => x = 6. (2+6)/2 = (y+5)/2 => 8 = y+5 => y = 3.

blocks.question: Find the coordinates of a point A, where AB is the diameter of a circle whose centre is (2, -3) and B is (1, 4).
blocks.question_hi: बिंदु A के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए, जहाँ AB एक वृत्त का व्यास है जिसका केंद्र (2, -3) है और B (1, 4) है।
blocks.question_gu: બિંદુ A ના યામ શોધો, જ્યાં AB એ વર્તુળનો વ્યાસ છે જેનું કેન્દ્ર (2, -3) છે અને B (1, 4) છે.
